title: Profile, Avatar & Digital Footprint
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 1 Week 2 Study sheet pp.9-11, Classwork, Homework

scenes.t: On the internet, your profile is your basic information, like your name, bio and picture.
Safety rules for your profile: use a fun nickname or just your first name. Never share your real full name.
Never write your school, your city or your neighborhood in your profile.
Turn on privacy settings, so only approved friends can see your posts. And let a parent manage your password.
An avatar is a picture or a cartoon character that represents you online. It does not have to be your real face!
To create an avatar: first select a boy or a girl. Then edit your avatar. Then download it.
To edit means to change something, like a post or a comment, if you make a mistake.
Your digital footprint is like footprints in the sand. When you walk on the beach, you leave marks behind.
On the internet, when you play games, watch videos, post pictures, or search for something, you leave little marks too.
So your digital footprint is all the information about you that stays online after you use the internet.
